senses.sense_definition: A type of white blood cell that helps the body fight infections.

examples.text: One litre of human blood contains about five billion <w>neutrophils</w> which make up half of all white blood cells.

target_lang_translations.zh: 一升人体血液中含有约五十亿个<w>中性粒细胞</w>，它们占所有白细胞的一半。

examples.text: When you cut yourself, white blood cells known as <w>neutrophils</w> travel to the injury to fight invading pathogens.

target_lang_translations.zh: 当你割伤自己时，被称为<w>中性粒细胞</w>的白细胞会移动到受伤部位以对抗入侵的病原体。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 一种白细胞，有助于身体抵抗感染。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 生物学中指一种具有吞噬功能的白细胞。

senses.sense_definition: Staining easily with neutral dyes rather than acidic or basic ones.

examples.text: The laboratory technician identified the <w>neutrophil</w> cells by their reaction to neutral dyes.

target_lang_translations.zh: 实验室技术员通过这些细胞对中性染料的反应识别出了<w>中性粒细胞</w>。

examples.text: These specific <w>neutrophil</w> structures are characterized by their affinity for neutral staining agents.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这些特定的<w>中性粒细胞</w>结构的特点是对中性染色剂具有亲和力。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 指容易被中性染料染色，而非酸性或碱性染料。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 形容词，指细胞对中性染料具有亲和力。
